description: This Java class named ProductCriteria extends Criteria and is used for specifying filtering and search parameters related to products, such as product name, category IDs, availability, manufacturer, and associated attribute criteria within the sales management system.

classes.name: ProductCriteria
classes.description: A class used for encapsulating product search and filtering criteria in the system, including product name, categories, availability, attributes, product IDs, and manufacturer ID.

methods.name: setProductName
methods.description: Sets the product name for filtering.

methods.name: getCategoryIds
methods.description: Gets the list of category IDs to filter products.

methods.name: setCategoryIds
methods.description: Sets the list of category IDs for product filtering.

methods.name: getAvailabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the list of availability statuses.

methods.name: setAvailabilities
methods.description: Sets the availability statuses for filtering.

methods.name: getAvailable
methods.description: Checks whether the product is available.

methods.name: getAttributeCriteria
methods.description: Gets the list of attribute criteria for filtering products based on attributes.

methods.name: getProductIds
methods.description: Retrieves the list of product IDs.

methods.name: setProductIds
methods.description: Sets the list of product IDs for filtering.

methods.name: getManufacturerId
methods.description: Gets the manufacturer ID associated with the criteria.

methods.name: setManufacturerId
methods.description: Sets the manufacturer ID for filtering.
